entries.source: Tandem paragliding in Alanya above Cleopatra Beach, Alanya Castle, the Mediterranean Sea and Taurus Mountains. Daily flights every 2 hours from 10:00 to 17:00. Price €75. Transfer, professional pilot, equipment, briefing and insurance included.
entries.translation: Tandem paragliding in Alanya above Cleopatra Beach, Alanya Castle, the Mediterranean Sea and Taurus Mountains. Daily flights every 2 hours from 10:00 to 17:00. Price €75. Transfer, professional pilot, equipment, briefing and insurance included.

entries.source: Experience the feeling of freedom with a professional tandem paragliding flight above Alanya. Fly from a mountain take-off point and enjoy panoramic views from up to 800 meters.
entries.translation: Experience the feeling of freedom with a professional tandem paragliding flight above Alanya. Fly from a mountain take-off point and enjoy panoramic views from up to 800 meters.

entries.source: is one of the most exciting ways to see the Turkish Riviera from above and feel the true freedom of flight.
entries.translation: is one of the most exciting ways to see the Turkish Riviera from above and feel the true freedom of flight.

entries.source: During the flight, you will see the famous
entries.translation: During the flight, you will see the famous

entries.source: , Alanya Castle and the historic peninsula, the azure Mediterranean Sea, the majestic Taurus Mountains and the panoramic coastline from up to 800 meters.
entries.translation: , Alanya Castle and the historic peninsula, the azure Mediterranean Sea, the majestic Taurus Mountains and the panoramic coastline from up to 800 meters.

entries.source: The flight is performed in tandem with a professional certified pilot, so the experience is suitable even for guests who have never tried paragliding before.
entries.translation: The flight is performed in tandem with a professional certified pilot, so the experience is suitable even for guests who have never tried paragliding before.

entries.source: Before take-off, you receive a detailed safety briefing. Then you take off smoothly from the mountain launch area and enjoy breathtaking views over Alanya.

entries.source: Wear secure lace-up sports shoes. Sandals, slippers and loose footwear are not suitable for take-off and landing.

entries.source: Guests must follow the pilot’s instructions during preparation, take-off, flight and landing. Final participation approval belongs to the pilot.

entries.source: Wear comfortable sports clothing and secure closed shoes. Loose items, jewellery and unsecured phones must be removed or safely stored.
entries.translation: Wear comfortable sports clothing and secure closed shoes. Loose items, jewellery and unsecured phones must be removed or safely stored.

entries.source: The activity may not be suitable during pregnancy or for guests with serious heart, back, neck, neurological or mobility conditions, recent surgery or severe fear of heights.
